correctness.rationale: For the row generator use pi_j=s_j/S and Pi=1 pi. The forward travel times satisfy Qm_j=pi_j^(−1)e_j−1; centering against pi produces G=(Q+Pi)^(−1)−Pi. Expanding the resolvent on the complement gives T=I+12G/h+O(h^(−2)); the stationary sector is identity. Pairing m_ij+m_ji=S and subtracting all unordered pairs from the adjacent pairs gives the claimed weighted sum for n≥4. For n=3, putting a=s_(j−1), b=s_(j+1), the centered term gives G_(j−1,j)=s_j(a s_j−b²)/S²; sum zero and simultaneous equality force homogeneous rates. For n=2 the nonstationary scalar lies strictly between zero and one for h>0 and Pi is positive. Independently checked homogeneous n=3 by using z²+3xz+3x²=0 on the two nonstationary modes z=x(omega−1): the identity (2−x−z)(2(x+1)+z)=x²+2x+4 reproduces the stated positive row. For n=4 evaluate R at 0, −2x, (−1±i)x and invert that four-point Fourier transform. Put A=x²+3x+3, B=x⁴+6x³+18x²+36x+36; R(−2x)=1−6x/A and Im R((−1+i)x)=6x(6−x²)/B. The forward entry becomes 3x[B+2A(6−x²)]/(2AB)=−3x(x⁴−24x²−72x−72)/(2AB); the other three are the stated positive rational entries. Descartes and endpoint signs give one positive root, and h=0 is identity. Replay: frozen RESULT.md proof and the identities here. The frozen verify.py was inspected, not executed; its finite checks and absent attestation/Lean status are not used as universal evidence.
